gloss: single eyelid; monolid (eyelid without a crease)

definitions.gloss: single eyelid; monolid (eyelid without a crease)
definitions.explanation: An eyelid that does not have a visible fold or crease above the eyelashes — one of the two basic Japanese descriptive categories for eyelid shape, the other being {二重|ふたえ}まぶた (double eyelid). Common in East Asian populations and a major topic in makeup and cosmetic-surgery discussions in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一重|ひとえ}まぶただ。
{一重|ひとえ}まぶた⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I am looking for makeup that suits single eyelids.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一重|ひとえ}まぶただった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧になった。
examples.english: I had single eyelids when I was a child, but they became double as I grew up.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧ (single layer, one-fold) and まぶた (eyelid). Describes an eyelid with no visible crease above the lash line. It is one of the standard physical-description terms in Japanese — not considered negative in itself, though many people who have {一重|ひとえ}まぶた discuss makeup tricks or cosmetic surgery (⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧⟦{整形|せいけい}→整形：09493_seikei⟧) to create a crease.

USAGE:
- Used both attributively ({一重|ひとえ}まぶた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ "a person with single eyelids") and as a predicate (⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一重|ひとえ}まぶたです "I have single eyelids").
- Paired frequently with its opposite ⟦{二重|ふたえ}まぶた→二重まぶた：23272_futaemabuta⟧ (double eyelid). Note that ⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧ here is read ふたえ, not にじゅう.
- Common in beauty magazines, makeup tutorials, and cosmetic-surgery advertisements. In casual speech, people often drop まぶた and say just ⟦{一重|ひとえ}→一重：06463_hitoe⟧ ("I'm a hitoe").

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, eyelid shape is discussed much more openly than in many Western countries. Double eyelids (⟦{二重|ふたえ}まぶた→二重まぶた：23272_futaemabuta⟧) are widely considered more fashionable, and products such as double-eyelid adhesive tapes and glues (アイプチ, アイテープ) are sold in drugstores. There are also people with ⟦{奥二重|おくぶたえ}→奥二重：29807_okubutae⟧ — a partial crease hidden behind the eyelid — which is often counted as its own category.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一重|ひとえ}まぶた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person with single eyelids
- {一重|ひとえ}まぶた⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{二重|ふたえ}→二重：06464_futae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go from single to double eyelids
- {一重|ひとえ}まぶた{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧: makeup designed for single eyelids
- {一重|ひとえ}まぶた⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧: to make the most of single eyelids

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二重|ふたえ}まぶた→二重まぶた：23272_futaemabuta⟧: double eyelid — the contrasting shape with a visible crease
- ⟦{奥二重|おくぶたえ}→奥二重：29807_okubutae⟧: hidden double eyelid — a crease that is partly hidden by the upper lid
- まぶた: eyelid — the base noun
- ⟦{目元|めもと}→目元：23407_memoto⟧: the area around the eyes — a broader cosmetic term
